decisions: Check order each cycle end: Markets.end_cycle, overhead, verdict (win then swept), bankrupt step, soft END_OUTCOMPETED at win_cycle_markets, then rescue stipend only if no repossession that cycle.
Gap rule uses the share at the previous cycle end; bot noise is a hash of (seed, bot, market, cycle) so saves reload to the same numbers. --seed=<int> fixes it.
n_active and overhead ignore common raws (summary R5): energy, food, ore never count as a market. Overhead = market_overhead x max(n-1,0)^2.
Rescue stipend now capped at rescue_max (2) per run; repossession credits salvage_share x ship_price; newest = a free ship first, else the route with the highest id.
